name: Metformin
description: A biguanide that reduces hepatic glucose production and improves peripheral insulin sensitivity, the first-line pharmacological agent for type 2 diabetes. Carries a boxed warning for lactic acidosis.

systems.note: Improved insulin sensitivity and reduced hepatic glucose output; the labelled indication.
Renally cleared; the boxed lactic acidosis warning is driven by renal accumulation.
Vitamin B12 malabsorption with long-term use is labelled.
Hepatic impairment raises lactic acidosis risk; labelled.

monitors.why: The direct index of glycaemic effect.
The boxed lactic acidosis warning is expressed in filtration thresholds.
Labelled long-term malabsorption; measured periodically per labelling.
Rises with B12 depletion, often before the B12 level is read.
